excluded_columns.readmitted: Original outcome column (the target itself) - direct leakage.
excluded_columns.encounter_id: Row identifier; carries no clinical signal and may encode time order.
excluded_columns.patient_nbr: Patient identifier; used ONLY as the grouping key for patient-aware splits.
excluded_columns.payer_code: ~40% missing administrative/insurance field; a socioeconomic proxy that adds fairness risk without being a clinical factor at discharge.
excluded_columns.race: Sensitive attribute. Excluded from model inputs to avoid encoding demographic bias; retained only for subgroup (fairness) evaluation.
excluded_columns.examide: Constant column (single value in the entire dataset).
excluded_columns.citoglipton: Constant column (single value in the entire dataset).
